description: Procurement for the Replacement of Petroleum Storage Tanks No.30 and 31 at the Kolonnawa Installation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminal Limited has planned to maintain a stock of petroleum products sufficient for at least 45 days to be used at any eventuality. In order to meet the said requirement, the construction of 6 new tanks with a capacity of 64,000 cubic meters has been commenced at the Kolonnawa Installation of the Company, and the procurement process for the construction of 3 new tanks with a capacity of 40,000 cubic meters has been commenced at the Muthurajawela terminal. In addition, it has also been planned to replace the existing tanks Nos.30 and 31 at the Kolonnawa installation with new tanks with a capacity of 7,000 cubic meters and 15,000 cubic meters respectively. Accordingly, taking into account the need to replace fuel storage tanks Nos.30 and 31 with new tanks to ensure continuous supply of petroleum products, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to initiate the procurement process for the said purpose utilizing the funds of Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminal Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.
